languageRestartBody: This lets the screen direction change correctly.
loginSubtitle: Enter your email and we'll send you a one-time code.
emailOtpFreshHint: We will email you a code.
emailOtpHint: No password needed. We'll email you a one-time code.
emailOtpSentBody: We sent a six-digit code to {{email}}.
emailOtpExistingCodeBody: Enter your email address and the six-digit code from your email.
adminUsePasswordInstead: Log in with a password instead
adminUseEmailOtpInstead: Log in with an email code instead
passwordTooShort: Password must be at least {{count}} characters.
accountUnresolvedTitle: We could not check your account
accountUnresolvedBody: Check your connection and try again. If it keeps happening, ask your organization's team.
teamHomeTitle: Your work is on the web dashboard
teamHomeBody: The app does not have a screen for your access yet. Everything you can do is on your organization's web dashboard, with the same email address.
secondFactorIntro: Open your authenticator app and type the six-digit code it shows for Ramassà.
secondFactorEnrollIntro: Your access needs a second step. Scan this code with an authenticator app (for example Google Authenticator or Microsoft Authenticator), then type the six-digit code it shows.
secondFactorQrAlt: QR code to add Ramassà to an authenticator app
secondFactorSecretLabel: Or type this key into the app:
secondFactorResetConfirm: This removes the person's authenticator and signs them out everywhere. At the next sign-in they set up a new one.
secondFactorResetDone: Second factor reset. They will set up a new one at the next sign-in.
signOutEverywhereConfirm: This ends every session of this person at once, on every device. They sign in again with their email code and authenticator.
stepUpIntro: This action needs a new code from your authenticator app.
appLockIntro: When the app lock is on, Ramassà asks for Face ID, your fingerprint or your phone's code when you come back to the app. This keeps other people's data safe if someone picks up your phone.
appLockUnavailable: Set a code on this phone first. The app lock uses the phone's own lock.
appLockLockedBody: Unlock with Face ID, your fingerprint or your phone's code.
